title: Local runtime liveness and audit harness resilience
goal: Make the local control plane reliable enough for enterprise acceptance testing: health checks must not hang, restart helpers must fully replace draining processes, and audit tools must write partial evidence when the app is unhealthy.
scope: Fix the observed condition where the inline host keeps listening on port 8000 while uvicorn is in shutdown/drain, `/health/live` times out, `/app/` navigation can hang under Playwright `networkidle`, and full-system audit scripts abort before writing useful defect evidence. Add a deterministic watchdog/restart contract for the local inline host, hard timeouts with actionable diagnostics, and audit-harness partial-output behavior for health/page-load failures.
generation_reason: During the enterprise readiness audit, `/health/live` returned 200 after restart but both `scripts/run_full_system_acceptance_audit.py` and `scripts/run_enterprise_ia_audit.py` later failed with timeouts. The host log showed `Shutting down` and `Waiting for connections to close` while port 8000 remained occupied. This blocks reliable product validation and mirrors operator reports of empty/hung screens.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Local runtime health, restart, and audit resilience only. Do not change assessment runner semantics, bypass safety gates, or add new live-target behavior.

success_criteria: Restart helpers detect and terminate a stuck draining inline host before declaring success.
`/health/live` responds or fails fast with actionable diagnostics under audit load.
Full-system and IA audit scripts write partial JSON/Markdown evidence when health or page navigation fails.
Playwright audit navigation does not rely on perpetual network idle when the app legitimately polls.
Settings/readiness surfaces can distinguish healthy, degraded, shutting-down, and unreachable local runtime states.
Tests cover healthy restart, stuck-port/draining process detection, audit partial-output behavior, and health timeout reporting.

required_checks: python3 scripts/run_enterprise_ia_audit.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --output-json codex/results/backlog-181-ia-audit.json --output-md codex/results/backlog-181-ia-audit.md --screenshot-dir codex/results/backlog-181-ia-screenshots
acceptance_criteria: A stuck old host cannot make restart report success.
Audit scripts leave a durable defect artifact even when health or navigation fails.
The local app remains reachable at `/app/` and `/health/live` after audit execution.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Replacing the UI polling model with WebSockets
